current_prompt.body:
APPLY the First Fit algorithm with bin capacity C = 10 to the item sequence Items = [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] in the given arrival order and REPORT the resulting bin assignments.
DETERMINE an optimal packing of the same items that uses the minimal number of bins and REPORT those bin assignments.
COMPUTE the difference in bin count between the First Fit result and the optimal result.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins than the optimal packing.
INCLUDE a SELF-TEST that VERIFIES both packings contain all items exactly once and obey the capacity limit of C = 10.
